explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that states this result. The theorem says that the library's own predicate `IsLagrangianVlasovSolutionOn` stays true when the time window shrinks from T to T' ≤ T. All of its mathematical content comes from that library definition. The proof takes the definition apart and restricts each component to the smaller window, using only generic facts: `lt_of_lt_of_le`, `Set.Ioo_subset_Ioo`, and `.mono` lemmas for the flow property and for continuity on a set. Mathlib has no notion of a Vlasov solution, so there is nothing for this theorem to duplicate. I did not search Mathlib, because its content cannot be there.
